items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My mother had a picture of her

ctx.x: My mother had a picture of her, I mean, like stunning.

Yes, yes. And she dressed in good taste. She was cute and she did it nicely, because there were some hags that had the clothes on, all that kind of stuff. Then the miniskirt came along. That just was disgusting, you know, to me. Oh, I saw these old women with those big knock knees in miniskirts. [laughs] I‘m not going to call any names. I don‘t know what marketing they did with me, because I sort of just floated in and out, you know.
